sn35.166:1.3: kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
sn35.166:1.4: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.166:1.5: rūpe dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.166:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.166:1.7: cakkhusamphassaṃ dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyati …pe…
sn35.166:1.8: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhato jānato passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyati.
sn35.166:1.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato sakkāyadiṭṭhi pahiyyatīti.
